nodes.label: Row Level Security Policy
nodes.rationale: RLS separates anon (app operator) INSERT rights from authenticated (admin) SELECT/DELETE rights, ensuring operators can save sessions but only admins can view or delete records.

nodes.label: Hindi Font Deferred Preload Pattern
nodes.rationale: Noto Sans Devanagari is loaded asynchronously in the background at DOMContentLoaded so it's ready by print time without blocking the UI or the synchronous window.open() call required for the print dialog.

nodes.label: Username-to-Email Auth Pattern
nodes.rationale: Users type a short name (e.g. 'paras'); the app appends AUTH_DOMAIN to form a Supabase Auth email. This avoids exposing real email addresses and keeps login UI simple.
